# TOPPLE

A small physics puzzle: knock the tower down with as few shots as possible. Pull back from the ball
and let go to shoot; crates fall, hit each other and set off chain reactions. Destruction is the point:
every collapse shakes the screen and throws debris.

## How it plays

- Click (or touch) and drag back to aim, release to shoot. The power is the length of the pull.
- Crates that fall far enough knock over the ones they land on: a chain reaction.
- Three levels; the best (fewest shots) per level is saved.

Fixed-step physics at 120 Hz with a seeded random generator, so the same shot gives the same result.
